event_chain.summary: Misdelivery - mail merge email exposed other families data

summary: Nottinghamshire County Council sent a school bus pass renewal reminder email, generated through a mail merge, that disclosed full names and reference numbers of dozens of students along with the names and email addresses of other parents and carers and individual renewal costs. The council apologised, asked recipients to delete the message, and its internal investigation found the incident met the threshold for reporting to the ICO.
